svg.aria-label: Schematic: a CN3303 boost charger fills a 3S Li-ion pack through a BMS and 5 A fuse; after the main switch the 9-12.6 V rail feeds the L298N, the NPK probe, a 20k/10k battery divider into A5 and an LM2596 buck set to 7.5 V for the Arduino VIN pin; the Arduino 5V pin powers the sensors and, via an AMS1117, 3.3 V for the nRF24L01. The nRF24L01 uses SPI on D9-D13, the HX710B D3/D4, the DHT22 D2, the MAX485 A2-A4 and the L298N D5-D8 plus A0/A1.
svg.text: 3 × 18650 Li-ion in series (3S) · 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full
Every ground symbol is the same common ground (battery P−).
Motor spins backwards? Swap its two wires.
